[about: https://skillcrown.co.uk/about-us] Skip to content About us Services All services Land Acquisition Portfolio Our Impact News Contact About us Skillcrown is a property developer renowned for our innovative design, exceptional construction standards and superior customer care. We create stunning and sophisticated homes providing long-term affordable solutions as well as commercial and hospitality premises, across London and the South East. Working with a host of the country’s very best housing associations and public bodies, our buildings are responsibly constructed, boasting features with flair and architectural excellence. Location, location, location Skillcrown has been developing homes of distinction for over 30 years and has a particular focus on delivering quality new homes across London and the South East. As a considerate property developer and contractor, in every location we work in we aim to provide a positive contribution to the community and are sympathetic to the surrounding area. High standards delivered! Our projects are as diverse as their locations and are driven by our highly-skilled and talented team – we ensure every project runs smoothly and professionally from conception through to completion upholding our high standards. Superior customer care We always endeavour to put our customers at the centre of everything we do to ensure we meet their needs and exceed expectations. All our homes are covered with a minimum 10-year building warranty, with insurance backed by one of the major industry regulators. Commitment to sustainability The Skillcrown team is committed to developing sustainable and environmentally-friendly developments. We are proud to have consistently achieve high-level ratings for energy efficiency, while also minimising the impact on the community and environment. We are always considering ways to improve our construction techniques to minimise our carbon footprint. This is achieved by continuously looking to adopt modern methods of construction for our future developments. Supporting the capital Acting as a main contractor for most of the UK’s leading housing associations, we are continually working towards providing a greater choice of affordable homes in London. We do our part in assisting with the housing crisis, delivering a range of housing tenures in the Capital and further afield. [service: https://skillcrown.co.uk/services] Skip to content About us Services All services Land Acquisition Portfolio Our Impact News Contact Services With an extensive and impressive offering of property development services, Skillcrown are experts in constructing homes, hotels and commercial premises, whilst maintaining all buildings to the highest standards. Take a look through our services below to find out more. Residential For over a quarter of a century, Skillcrown has been building exceptional homes, providing safety and security for families of today and the future. Our in-house construction team ensures our exacting standards are met throughout the entire design and build process; the end result boasts exemplary standards of workmanship. What’s more, every Skillcrown home has the added benefit of a minimum 10-year building warranty, insurance backed by one of the major industry regulators. Hospitality At Skillcrown, we build modern, sustainable hotels, which help to boost the local economy and provide comfortable temporary living spaces. We are passionate about creating innovative, imaginative accommodation of exceptional design and specification. Maintenance With a dedicated, highly skilled customer care division, we ensure all our customer queries and concerns are a priority, assuring their every need and expectations are met with a reliable and responsive service. Our maintenance team ensure all our buildings function to the highest possible standards, in the most effective way, while consistently achieving high levels of customer satisfaction. Commercial Whether it’s an office, retail or warehousing space that’s needed, Skillcrown delivers outstanding commercial property efficiently and cost-effectively. Our approach to each project is always consistent – we strive to create the best possible environment for everyone who interacts with our buildings, whether it’s workers, guests or visitors. Land aquisition Skillcrown has a vast experience of developing an extensive variety of sites and we are always seeking new opportunities with or without a planning consent. Committed to working closely with land owners and Local Authorities, our talented team has the ability to extract value from every opportunity. We are also happy to consider projects that have an adverse planning history. [service: https://skillcrown.co.uk/services/land-acquisition] Skip to content About us Services All services Land Acquisition Portfolio Our Impact News Contact Land Acquisition At Skillcrown, we are always scouring the market for new development opportunities and when the right site comes forward, we are able to act quickly and decisively. Our team combines planning insight with construction expertise, allowing us to evaluate each opportunity not only on purchase price, but on deliverability, programme, risk and financial viability. On & off market opportunities We source opportunities both on and off market, drawing on an extensive site database, a strong understanding of planning policy and long-standing professional relationships. By managing the process in-house, we streamline decision-making, reduce unnecessary costs and maintain momentum from first contact through to acquisition. Practical & design-led approach We focus on creating proposals that planning authorities can support because they enhance the local area through high-quality, sustainable design. We also place real emphasis on maintaining positive relationships with neighbours and stakeholders, recognising that successful development depends on trust, communication and careful management from the outset. Acquisition, planning & construction From acquisition through planning and construction to final completion and landscaping, we apply the same care and attention at every stage to protect quality and maintain momentum. Our focus is on delivering schemes that are robust, well detailed and designed around the needs of the end user. Our experience spans a wide range of residential-led projects, from single homes through to larger mixed-use and commercial-led developments. All site types considered We will consider a broad range of site types, particularly previously developed land and underutilised premises, including former car dealerships, yards, petrol filling stations, offices, warehouses and redundant agricultural buildings, as well as land assemblies.
